conflictOfInterest.details: Founding-stage isolation check: the accountable principal VSBDev operates the authoring, review, and finalization agents, so principal-level independence is absent. Agent-level role isolation was strictly maintained: no authoring history, other review output, or adjudication draft was read, and no other EmbeddedKnowledge role script was run during this review execution.

findings.finding: The worked example 'worked-example-sample-size-for-eighty-percent' is missing a self-explanation prompt about the decision that most strongly determines the solution. According to CONTENT-STANDARD.md Section 5.1, every worked example must include this element to guide initial learning.
findings.resolution: Revise the worked example block to include a self-explanation prompt (e.g. asking the learner to explain why the required sample size scales with the inverse square of the target difference/effect size).

findings.finding: First-read check: The orientation scene successfully engages the learner with a concrete clinical dataset (the dinner-timing study results) and poses clear, motivating questions about null hypothesis testing, power, and multiplicity. The diagnostic check and recovery path are well-designed and fully aligned with CONTENT-STANDARD.md guidelines.

Visual representation: The dual normal-curve chart (power-null-and-alternative.chart.json) successfully maps the null and alternative distributions onto a single axis, clearly distinguishing alpha, beta, and power relative to the critical value threshold. The prose explicitly coordinates with the chart and labels the exact area calculations.

Practice and Transfer: The lesson features excellent practice items in Scene 6 and genuine transfer tasks in Scene 7 (blood-panel test multiplicity and physiotherapy pilot sample size/power analysis) that push the learner to select and adapt the models in new clinical domains.

limitations: Expert-simulation review: This review represents a single-pass advisory input by a simulated learning-design expert under standard-lesson-v3 guidelines. No real learner testing was conducted.
Conflict of interest: The same GitHub principal (VSBDev) is responsible for the authoring and review run operators. Agent-level isolation was maintained, but principal-level independence is absent.

Scope restriction: The review is strictly bounded to learning-design metrics (e.g., clarity, coherence, practice, alignment, and transfer). Scientific accuracy, rights audits, and final typesetting checks are excluded.

Technical verification limits: No rendered build environment, screen reader, or keyboard navigation pathways were evaluated physically; findings are based solely on the static Markdown and JSON source files.
